name: Attitude Engine
description: A pure, zero-dependency function: machine-readable Attitude Profile in, Behavior Card out (behavior_config + system-prompt block + non-overridable bounds). Bounds always override attitude — structural, not advisory.
tagline: Turn identity + attitude into agent behavior
caption: Attitude Engine — Turn identity + attitude into agent behavior. Tune the 10 attitude dimensions, set your bounds, get a behavior config and a system-prompt block where bounds override attitude by construction.
honest_limits: Editorial inference in the reference profile is labeled editorial. Bounds are only as good as the profile author writes them.
